events.raw_text: FORM 8-K: Apple Inc (AAPL) reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $98.3 billion, up 9% YoY. iPhone revenue grew 6% to $48.2 billion. Services hit record $24.1 billion.
FORM 8-K: Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $65.6 billion, up 12%. Azure grew 29%. Intelligent Cloud segment revenue was $25.5 billion.
FORM 8-K: Alphabet Inc (GOOGL) reported Q4 2025 revenue of $86.3 billion. Search revenue grew 11%. Cloud turned profitable with $864 million operating income.
FORM 8-K: Amazon.com Inc (AMZN) reported Q4 2025 revenue of $170.0 billion, up 10%. AWS revenue was $24.2 billion, up 19%. Operating income was $14.2 billion.
FORM 8-K: Meta Platforms (META) reported Q4 2025 revenue of $40.1 billion, up 21%. Family daily active people reached 3.19 billion. Reality Labs losses were $4.6 billion.
FORM 8-K: Tesla Inc (TSLA) reported Q4 2025 revenue of $25.2 billion, missing estimates of $26.3 billion. Automotive gross margin fell to 16.3%. Deliveries were 484,507 units.
FORM 8-K: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) reported Q4 FY2026 revenue of $39.3 billion, up 78%. Data Center revenue was $35.6 billion. Gross margin was 73.0%.
FORM 8-K: Netflix Inc (NFLX) added 18.9 million paid subscribers in Q4, beating estimates by 9 million. Revenue was $10.2 billion. Will stop reporting subscriber numbers.
FORM 8-K: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reported Q4 2025 net income of $14.0 billion, up 50%. Investment banking fees surged 46%. Net interest income was $23.5 billion.
FORM 8-K: Bank of America (BAC) reported Q4 net income of $6.7 billion. Net interest income grew 3% to $14.4 billion. Trading revenue up 10% to $4.1 billion.
FORM 8-K: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) reported Q4 revenue of $100.8 billion, up 8%. Medical care ratio was 85.5%, higher than expected. Optum revenue was $62.9 billion.
FORM 8-K: Salesforce Inc (CRM) reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $9.9 billion, up 11%. RPO reached $53 billion. Operating margin expanded to 33.1%.
FORM 8-K: Walmart Inc (WMT) reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $164.0 billion. US comp sales grew 5.3%. E-commerce grew 27%. Raised full-year guidance again.
FORM 8-K: Target Corp (TGT) missed Q3 earnings estimates. Comparable sales declined 4.9%. Inventory grew 14% amid slowing consumer demand. Lowered guidance.
FORM 8-K: Costco Wholesale (COST) reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $61.4 billion. Comp sales grew 5.2%. Membership fee income was $1.17 billion. Renewal rate 93%.
FORM 8-K: Snap Inc (SNAP) reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1.24 billion, missing estimates of $1.36 billion. DAU grew only 2% to 422 million.
FORM 8-K: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) reported Q4 revenue of $608 million, up 20%. US commercial revenue grew 40%. Raised FY2026 guidance above consensus.
FORM 8-K: Walt Disney (DIS) reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $24.7 billion. Disney+ added 7 million subscribers. Parks revenue grew 6%. Streaming turned profitable.
FORM 8-K: Intel Corp (INTC) reported Q4 revenue of $14.3 billion, down 12% YoY. Data center revenue fell 10%. Foundry services recorded $7 billion loss.
FORM 8-K: AMD reported Q4 revenue of $6.8 billion, up 10%. Data center revenue hit $3.9 billion record. AI accelerator revenue was $3.5 billion.
FORM 8-K: Eli Lilly (LLY) received FDA approval for tirzepatide for obstructive sleep apnea, the first drug approved for this condition linked to obesity.
FORM 8-K: Pfizer (PFE) received FDA approval for Abrysvo RSV vaccine for adults aged 32-59, expanding the eligible population significantly.
FORM 8-K: Moderna (MRNA) received FDA breakthrough therapy designation for its personalized cancer vaccine mRNA-4157 in combination with Keytruda.
FORM 8-K: AbbVie (ABBV) FDA rejected supplemental application for Rinvoq in lupus nephritis, citing insufficient efficacy data. Shares fell on the news.
FORM 8-K: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) received FDA approval for RYBREVANT plus chemo as first-line treatment for non-small cell lung cancer with EGFR mutations.
FORM 8-K: Broadcom Inc (AVGO) completed VMware acquisition integration. Combined entity expects $8.5 billion in annualized synergies by end of 2026.
FORM 8-K: Adobe (ADBE) announced acquisition of Figma is officially terminated after regulatory challenges. Adobe will pay $1 billion breakup fee.
FORM 8-K: Cisco Systems (CSCO) completed $28 billion Splunk acquisition. Expects deal to be accretive to non-GAAP EPS in FY2026. Integration underway.
FORM 8-K: Uber Technologies (UBER) announced $1.5 billion acquisition of autonomous trucking company Aurora Innovation to accelerate freight automation.
FORM 8-K: Goldman Sachs (GS) agreed to sell GreenSky lending platform to a consortium for $2.2 billion, taking a $1.5 billion loss on the 2022 acquisition.
FORM 8-K: Tesla (TSLA) CFO Vaibhav Taneja resigned citing personal reasons. Company appointed interim CFO from existing finance team.
FORM 8-K: Intel (INTC) CEO Pat Gelsinger retired from the company. Board appointed David Zinsner and Michelle Johnston Holthaus as interim co-CEOs.
FORM 8-K: Nike Inc (NKE) announced Elliott Hill as new President and CEO, replacing retiring John Donahoe effective October 14, 2025.
FORM 8-K: Starbucks (SBUX) named Chipotle CEO Brian Niccol as new chairman and CEO. Niccol credited with Chipotle's turnaround.
FORM 8-K: Boeing (BA) CEO Dave Calhoun announced plans to step down by end of year amid ongoing 737 MAX safety concerns and production issues.
FORM 4: Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk sold 4.4 million shares worth approximately $1.8 billion. Filing indicates sales for tax obligation on exercised options.
FORM 4: NVIDIA (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang sold 600,000 shares under 10b5-1 trading plan at average price of $138.50, total value $83.1 million.
FORM 4: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) CEO Jamie Dimon sold $150 million in JPM stock, his first sale in 18 years at the company. Sold at average price of $210.
FORM 8-K: Apple Inc (AAPL) authorized $110 billion share repurchase program, the largest in US corporate history. Also increased quarterly dividend 4%.
FORM 8-K: Alphabet (GOOGL) announced $70 billion share buyback program and first-ever quarterly dividend of $0.20 per share.
FORM 8-K: Meta Platforms (META) added $50 billion to share buyback authorization. Total remaining authorization now $80.6 billion.
FORM 8-K: Walt Disney (DIS) announced restructuring plan eliminating 7,000 jobs across entertainment and ESPN segments. Expected savings of $5.5 billion.
FORM 8-K: Pfizer (PFE) announced $4 billion cost-cutting program including 3,500 job reductions and facility consolidations. Expects savings by end 2027.
FORM 8-K: Intel (INTC) announced plan to cut 15,000 jobs, reduce capex by 20%, and suspend dividend to preserve cash during foundry ramp.
FORM 8-K: Target (TGT) lowered Q4 guidance, now expects comparable sales decline of 3-5%. Cited slowing discretionary spending and inventory challenges.
FORM 8-K: Microsoft (MSFT) raised Q3 FY2026 Azure growth guidance to 31-32%, citing strong AI workload demand. Expects $80 billion in capex for AI.
FORM 8-K: Amazon (AMZN) guided Q1 2026 revenue of $151-155.5 billion, below consensus of $158.4 billion. AWS growth guided to 19%.
FORM 8-K: Caterpillar (CAT) reported Q4 revenue of $16.6 billion, missing estimates. Construction equipment sales declined 5% in North America.
FORM 8-K: Visa Inc (V) reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $9.5 billion, up 10%. Cross-border volume grew 16%. Processed 56.4 billion transactions.
FORM 8-K: Mastercard (MA) reported Q4 revenue of $7.4 billion, up 14%. Cross-border volume grew 18%. Net income was $3.2 billion.
FORM 8-K: Goldman Sachs (GS) reported Q4 net income of $4.1 billion, up 51%. Investment banking revenue surged 24% to $2.1 billion. Equities trading revenue record $3.5 billion.
FORM 8-K: Morgan Stanley (MS) reported Q4 revenue of $16.2 billion, up 26%. Wealth management revenue was $7.5 billion. Investment banking fees up 29%.
FORM 8-K: Chevron (CVX) reported Q4 earnings of $5.5 billion. Permian Basin production grew 12%. Announced $2.5 billion accelerated buyback.
FORM 8-K: ExxonMobil (XOM) reported Q4 earnings of $8.9 billion. Production hit company record of 4.6 million boe/d. Guyana output grew 15%.
FORM 8-K: Procter & Gamble (PG) reported Q2 FY2026 organic sales growth of 4%. Health care segment led with 8% growth. Maintained full-year outlook.
FORM 8-K: Home Depot (HD) reported Q4 revenue of $34.8 billion. Comp sales fell 3.5% as housing market remained weak. Customer transactions down 2.6%.
FORM 8-K: McDonald's (MCD) reported Q4 global comp sales grew 4.3%. US same-store sales grew 3.2%. Digital orders were 40% of total systemwide sales.
FORM 8-K: Nike (NKE) reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $12.4 billion, down 8% YoY. North America revenue fell 12%. Direct-to-consumer sales down 4%.
FORM 8-K: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B) reported Q4 operating earnings of $10.8 billion. Cash position reached $188 billion. Insurance underwriting profit $3.4 billion.
FORM 8-K: Charles Schwab (SCHW) reported Q4 net new assets of $109 billion. Total client assets $9.1 trillion. Net interest revenue grew 5% to $2.4 billion.
FORM 8-K: TSMC (TSM) reported Q4 revenue of $26.3 billion, up 39%. 3nm accounted for 26% of revenue. 2nm on track for production in late 2025.
FORM 8-K: Qualcomm (QCOM) reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $11.4 billion, up 17%. QCT automotive revenue grew 55%. Raised Q2 guidance above Street.
FORM 8-K: NextEra Energy (NEE) reported Q4 adjusted EPS of $0.51, missing estimates. Development pipeline remains robust at 25 GW but near-term margins pressured.
Apple (AAPL) launched Vision Pro 2 at $2,999 with major improvements: 2x resolution, 3-hour battery, prescription lens support. Pre-orders exceeded 500,000 in first weekend.
Google (GOOGL) launched Gemini Ultra 2.0, claiming 3x improvement over GPT-5 on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Available immediately in Workspace and Cloud.
Tesla (TSLA) began deliveries of Model 2 compact vehicle at $25,000 base price. First 10,000 units delivered in week one. Waitlist exceeds 500,000.
Amazon (AMZN) announced $10 billion investment in Indian market, plans to hire 100,000 workers. Will expand grocery delivery to 50 new cities.
EU regulators fined Meta Platforms (META) 1.2 billion euros for GDPR violations related to data transfers. Meta plans to appeal the decision.
US DOJ proposed breaking up Google (GOOGL) search business in antitrust remedy. Judge to rule on proposed remedies by Q3 2026.
EU Digital Markets Act forces Apple (AAPL) to allow sideloading on iPhone in Europe. Apple warns of security risks. Analysts estimate 5% App Store revenue impact.
DOJ opens antitrust investigation into UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Optum unit over potential anti-competitive practices in physician practice acquisitions.
Boeing (BA) 737 MAX 9 grounded by FAA after mid-air door plug blowout on Alaska Airlines flight. All 171 MAX 9 aircraft worldwide ordered inspected.
Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) reached $8.9 billion settlement for talc cancer lawsuits covering 100,000 claimants. Company to take one-time charge in Q1.
US Commerce Department tightened AI chip export controls to China, directly impacting NVIDIA (NVDA) H100 and H200 sales. NVDA estimates $5B revenue impact.
AMD (AMD) announced strategic partnership with Microsoft for custom AI chips. Azure to deploy AMD Instinct MI400 accelerators in 20 data center regions.
Salesforce (CRM) announced strategic partnership with NVIDIA to integrate AI Enterprise into Salesforce Data Cloud. Joint solution targets enterprise AI adoption.
Walmart (WMT) announced plan to open 150 new US stores over 5 years and remodel 650 existing locations. Total investment of $9 billion.
FORM 8-K: Costco (COST) announced membership fee increase of $5 for Gold Star and $10 for Executive members, first increase in 7 years.
Disney (DIS) Disney+ subscriber count declined 1.3 million in Q2. Company raised streaming prices 10% and cracked down on password sharing.
Netflix (NFLX) secured exclusive 10-year deal with WWE for $5 billion, bringing Monday Night Raw and premium events to the streaming platform.
FORM 8-K: Microsoft (MSFT) expanded OpenAI partnership with additional $10 billion investment. Azure exclusive cloud provider through 2030. New GPT-5 integration planned.
FORM 8-K: Broadcom (AVGO) reported Q1 FY2026 revenue of $14.1 billion, up 44%. AI-related revenue was $3.7 billion. VMware integration on track.
FORM 8-K: Eli Lilly (LLY) reported Q4 revenue of $11.4 billion, up 28%. Mounjaro/Zepbound sales were $4.5 billion combined. Raised 2026 guidance.
FORM 8-K: AbbVie (ABBV) reported Q4 revenue of $15.1 billion. Skyrizi/Rinvoq combined sales of $5.0 billion. Humira erosion stabilizing.
FORM 8-K: Pfizer (PFE) reported Q4 revenue of $14.2 billion, down 7%. COVID product revenue was $2.1 billion. Oncology portfolio grew 18%.
FORM 8-K: Boeing (BA) reported Q4 loss of $4.2 billion. Commercial airplane deliveries of 93 units, below target. 737 MAX production still below plan.
FORM 8-K: Goldman Sachs (GS) raised medium-term ROE target to 17-18% from 15-17%. Plans to grow asset management to $3 trillion AUM by 2028.
NVIDIA (NVDA) unveiled Blackwell Ultra B300 GPU at GTC 2026 with 2x inference performance over H200. Major cloud providers commit to billion-dollar orders.
Meta (META) launched Llama 4 open-source AI model, matching GPT-4 performance. Available free for commercial use. 100,000 downloads in first 24 hours.
NHTSA opened investigation into Tesla (TSLA) Full Self-Driving software after 12 reported crashes involving pedestrians. 2.4 million vehicles potentially affected.
FORM 8-K: Amazon (AMZN) reported Q1 2026 revenue of $155.7 billion, above guidance. AWS grew 21% to $29.3 billion. Operating income $17.2 billion.
FORM 8-K: Microsoft (MSFT) reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $70.1 billion, up 15%. Azure grew 31%. Copilot enterprise seats reached 5 million.
FORM 8-K: Alphabet (GOOGL) reported Q1 2026 revenue of $92.3 billion. Cloud revenue $12.3 billion with $1.2 billion profit. YouTube ad revenue $9.8 billion.
FORM 8-K: Meta (META) reported Q1 2026 revenue of $42.3 billion, up 25%. Reality Labs losses narrowed to $3.8 billion. Family DAP 3.3 billion.
FORM 8-K: Apple (AAPL) reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $95.4 billion, up 5%. iPhone revenue $46.8 billion. Services revenue $23.6 billion record.
FORM 8-K: Tesla (TSLA) reported Q1 2026 revenue of $21.3 billion, down 9% YoY. Deliveries 386,810 units, below 414,000 expected. Automotive gross margin 15.4%.
FORM 8-K: NVIDIA (NVDA) reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $44.0 billion, up 69%. Data center revenue $40.4 billion. Guided Q2 to $48 billion.
FORM 8-K: JPMorgan (JPM) reported Q1 2026 net income of $13.4 billion. Net interest income $23.2 billion. Investment banking fees $2.3 billion.
FORM 8-K: Bank of America (BAC) reported Q1 2026 net income of $7.4 billion. Net interest income $14.6 billion, up 8%. Trading revenue record $5.2 billion.
FORM 8-K: Walmart (WMT) reported Q4 FY2026 revenue of $173.4 billion, up 4.1%. E-commerce grew 20%. Global advertising business surpassed $4 billion annually.
